sources.what: The flags of what the lists of scripts/data/flags-lists.json name (countries that are no more, organisations, peoples), by its Wikidata id. items: the Commons file of the flag it flies today (file), whether Wikidata prefers it to the others (rank), since when (from) and the others it gives as of today (also); those it stopped flying (past), the last first, each with its file and the days it flew between, which is all that something that is no more has; and by: hand when the flag is one given in scripts/data/flags-hand.json, with the one Wikidata gave under instead. files: what Commons says of each file, by its title: SHA-1, bytes, MIME type, width and height, licence and its address, author, credit, whether it must be attributed, restrictions other than copyright, and its page; where the file is kept in this branch (kept); the 960 px picture that Wikimedia draws of it (picture), which stands for an original of more than 2 MB and goes with a drawing that has words in it (words); for a photograph, the drawing of the same flag that is kept in its place (drawn); and the categories of Commons it is in that speak of other times, of a proposal or of an invention, which may mean that it is not a flag that flies (marks). The files themselves are under flags/files, each named after its SHA-1.
sources.es: Banderas de países que ya no existen, de organizaciones y de pueblos
